items.mainDefect: On restart, a hung threading.Thread worker cannot be stopped (only multiprocessing.Process is killed), so a replacement worker runs alongside it, flushing the same shards and sharing state.

secondary.defect: _create_process_for_shards overwrites self.buffers[process_index] with a new SpansBuffer without closing the old one.

items.mainDefect: The restart path's isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) check is False for SpawnProcess objects, so hung processes are never killed before a replacement is spawned.

secondary.defect: The same isinstance check in join() means terminate() is never called on the spawned flusher processes.

items.mainDefect: The hung-process kill on restart is guarded by isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process), which is False for SpawnProcess objects, so kill() is never called and duplicate flushers run on the same shards.

secondary.defect: The same isinstance check in join() means terminate() is never called on the spawned flusher processes.
